review_text: I had a good experience at Limestone Brew in Samal Island. The food was definitely enjoyable—everything we ordered tasted fresh and well-prepared, and you can tell they put effort into the quality of their dishes. That said, the prices are a bit on the higher side, which might make you think twice if you’re on a budget. Still, the ambiance makes up for it. It’s a nice, relaxing spot to just sit back, enjoy your meal, and unwind, especially if you’re looking for a chill café vibe while on the island. Overall, it’s a solid place to visit if you don’t mind spending a little extra for good food and a comfortable atmosphere.

The food was incredibly delicious — every dish was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully served. Tried the baby back ribs and gambas, really a must try! The ambience was cozy and relaxing, making it a perfect spot to enjoy a meal and unwind. Highly recommended, and I’ll definitely be coming back!

Their internet is incredibly fast, their service is topnotch and we were able to finish a lot of work before going home. They also have a piano and they allowed my kid to play a piece. And of course, I love their coffee!

Limestone Brew never disappoints, first in the island to offer both quality and vibes! Pa balik-balik ko diri since its year of establishment. This is SB of Samal, but even if naa nay SB sa island, TLB gihapon :>
Small portion Carbonara was too soft therefore mushy which tastes reheated and the Pork in BBQ sauce was not tasty and tough. The caramel milkshakes were very good.
Super cozy cafe. I’m surprised it doesn’t get too much crowded and noisy. Definitely a break from the rush of city life 🍃☕️ …

Very nice and clean place with aesthetic, Instagram-worthy vibes. Spacious for customers and very affordable. Their baby back ribs are a must-try—100/100! Very near the port, and if you’re from Davao, you must visit Limestone to enjoy their delicious food and perfect ambiance!
place is clean and aesthetic.food is good but on the above average price. we ordered baby back ribs and a pasta

The place is cozy and spacious, perfect to chill and spend time with your loved ones and friends. They also have free Wi-Fi and payment options like Cash, GCash, PayMaya, and Credit/Debit Cards. I also love that they sell different kinds of merch — from clothing products made of flour sacks, various types of tote bags, their tumbler, and the Himaya Cassava Chips. The staff are kind, friendly, and accommodating. Their food and drinks are so good! I love their Carbonara & Cheesy Bacon Fries the most! Regarding their drinks, I can recommend The Limestone Blend & Ceremonial Matcha Oat, but you can try the other drinks, too! 💚 A must-place to visit when you’re on the island!

The place is nice. The staff are nice. The serving of the food didn't take too long, but maybe we expected too much with the food since it was pricey. We order the chicken with Honey and Garlic on it. The sauce was good, but the chicken was hard to chew (makunat). It was like eating bubblegum and it was not satisfying at all. We expected it was worth our money. But the place is super cozy, since it was super humid at the island.
Great food, Crazy and amazing staff, and a relaxing ambiance. Limestone Brew never disappoints! 👌”

Wish I could give a 4.5 instead but only docked points because, sadly, some food items were unavailable during our stay. Nonetheless, great overall experience.
